title: Release documentation and verification checklist
description:
Author release verification documentation that maps SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §21–§22 to automated vs manual checks, and summarize what phase L (and prior phases) cover in CI versus what requires host validation.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- scripts/validate.sh from l.1 (what is actually automated)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §21 Testing (21.1–21.10) and §22 Release Criteria
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18–§19 RT and latency requirements
- tests/*Tests.cpp inventory and phase skeletons A–K deliverables
- CMakePresets.json / scripts/build_all.sh for documented build commands

Create docs/verification/shredeq_release.md:
1. Title and purpose: ShredEQ v1.0 release verification checklist.
2. How to run automated gates: scripts/validate.sh; cmake Release build; ctest; note Linux-first CI expectation.
3. Checklist table or sections mirroring every §22 bullet, each tagged:
   - VERIFIED_IN_CI / AUTOMATED (script or unit test)
   - PARTIAL (source/static or unit-level only)
   - MANUAL_REQUIRED (host/DAW/pluginval/Windows)
4. Expand §21.1–21.10 into the same honesty model: filter response, stability, dynamic EQ, multiband, Chug, resonance, pitch, state, host validation (Bitwig Linux, REAPER Linux/Windows, pluginval, standalone), audio regression.
5. Explicitly document that external sidechain, mono/stereo host layouts, offline render, project reopen-in-host, GUI DPI/resize, and Windows Release builds cannot be claimed CI-green solely from scripts/validate.sh unless those tools are integrated — list manual procedure stubs.
6. Zero-latency / reported latency: state default mode reports 0; lookahead modes report non-zero with PDC when enabled.
7. Bypass click-free and A/B/gain-match: point to automated symbols/tests vs ear/host checks.
8. Factory presets: categorized + gain-conscious criteria and path Resources/Presets/.
9. Sign-off template: operator initials / date / git SHA fields (empty placeholders).

Create docs/verification/shredeq_phase_summary.md:
1. One section per implementation phase A–L with: focus, key deliverables, primary tests/artifacts.
2. Call out fan-in ownership pattern (CMakeLists / Processor / Editor) briefly.
3. State overall maturity: what ship blockers remain if only CI has run.
4. Link/relative-path reference to shredeq_release.md and scripts/validate.sh.

Do not modify Source, CMake, presets, or the validation script. Be honest — never mark host-only items as CI-verified.
